title: Intel Climbs 15% on Apple Chip Deal as Trader Warns on Upcoming Cisco Earnings
title_zh: 苹果芯片交易推动英特尔股价上涨 15%，交易员对思科即将公布的财报发出警告
summary: Friday’s CNBC Halftime Report on May 8 featured two very different AI market stories unfolding at the same time.
summary_zh: 5 月 8 日周五的 CNBC 半场报道讲述了同时展开的两个截然不同的人工智能市场故事。

title: Magnum Ice Cream shares surge on report of PE buyout interest
title_zh: PE 收购兴趣报道导致 Magnum 冰淇淋股价飙升
summary: Investing.com -- Magnum Ice Cream Nv (NYSE:MICC) shares jumped 10.9% in U.S. premarket trading and 10.5% in European markets on Friday following reports of potential private equity interest.
summary_zh: Investing.com——周五，在有关潜在私募股权投资的报道之后，Magnum Ice Cream Nv (NYSE:MICC) 股价在美国盘前交易中上涨 10.9%，在欧洲市场上涨 10.5%。

title: Blackstone Walks Away From $4 Billion New World Deal
title_zh: Blackstone 放弃 40 亿美元的新世界交易
summary: New World now faces pressure to resolve airport mall liabilities and secure capital before its annual audit.
summary_zh: 新世界现在面临着在年度审计之前解决机场购物中心负债和确保资本的压力。

title: The Dealmaking 3: F1 Revenue History, MLS PE Partnership, Youth Sports Growth

summary_zh: 观看本周的《The Dealmaking 3》：本周由“体育教授”Rick Horrow 主持的《The Dealmaking 3》由 KKR & Co. Inc. 报道。

title: The PE Paradox: Volatility Fuels New Deals as Old Assets Sit Frozen in Portfolios
title_zh: 私募股权悖论：旧资产在投资组合中冻结，波动性助长新交易
summary: Glinting investment opportunities abound, private-equity firms say—but the industry also faces an exit bottleneck of over $3 trillion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司表示，闪闪发光的投资机会比比皆是，但该行业也面临着超过 3 万亿美元的退出瓶颈。
